overview: Join our friendly nurse-led care team in Crieff, Strathearn, and surrounding Perthshire communities. Medication prompting and assistance under nurse guidance
Preparing nutritious meals and encouraging hydration
Warm companionship, social interaction, and checking in on wellbeing
Light domestic tasks, tidying, and maintaining a comfortable home
Assisting with appointments and local shopping trips around Crieff
whatWeOffer: £14.50 to £16.50 per hour with enhanced holiday pay
Full paid training, induction, and shadowed shifts
SSSC registration support and fully funded SVQ qualifications
Generous mileage allowance (45p/mile) and paid travel time
Flexible shift patterns (mornings, evenings, weekends, or zero-hours)
